verdict.rationale: GlitchTip documents no built-in AI that analyzes an issue's stack trace, breadcrumbs, and commits to propose a root cause. Its built-in MCP server only exposes error data to the user's own external AI assistants, which makes it a building block rather than the platform's own AI analysis. Tools like detect_n_plus_one do pattern detection, not issue-level root-cause proposals, so neither earns credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform's AI analyzes an issue — stack trace, breadcrumbs, related commits — and proposes a root cause I can act on
